decisions.reason: Switching to the Advanced Edition for CRM integration does not change the requirement to configure a lead-source list in Sales Navigator.
The plan switch establishes CRM integration capability but does not change the required type of LinkedIn profile URL stored in HubSpot.
The source does not establish any change to duplicate-status visibility while viewing a LinkedIn profile.
Sales Navigator CRM integration capability does not necessarily change synchronization or visibility of email and LinkedIn chat history.
The Sales Navigator plan switch does not change the separate Zap-based HubSpot-to-MeetAlfred synchronization method.
The source changes the Sales Navigator edition used for direct CRM integration, not the configured HubSpot lead-management features.
The automated LinkedIn campaign remains a separate MeetAlfred behavior unaffected by the Sales Navigator edition switch.
The selected Advanced Edition is a Sales Navigator plan; the source does not change HubSpot's Starter subscription or CRM configuration.
The source does not change the workflow for moving silent leads into MeetAlfred follow-up campaigns.
Changing the Sales Navigator edition does not necessarily alter the independent requirement to configure MeetAlfred.
The source establishes a direct LinkedIn-to-HubSpot capability but does not remove or modify the separately required Zapier configuration.
The Sales Navigator plan selection does not change the separate automated email campaign configured through MeetAlfred.
